.kitchen
Masala makhana resipi | phul makhana masala | vistrit photo aur vidiyo nuskha ke sath bhuna huaa kamal ke bij nashta. kamal ke bij aur sukhe masalon ke sath banaya gaya ek aasan aur saral svasth snaik resipi. yah aamtaur par upvas ke dauran banaya aur parosa jata hai kyonki ismen upvas ke dauran sabhi aavashyak poshak tatv hote hain. nuskha shayad hi kaee samagri leta hai lekin sargarmi men bahut samay lagta hai aur islie nausikhiya sheph ke lie bhari ho sakta hai.
